hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; & py -3 -B (Join-Path $root 'shared\gates\harness_gate.py') --host codex --event SessionStart"
powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; & py -3 -B (Join-Path $root 'shared\gates\harness_gate.py') --host codex --event UserPromptSubmit"
powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; & py -3 -B (Join-Path $root 'shared\gates\harness_gate.py') --host codex --event Stop"
